mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Ripplr's mission is to transform the Distribution sector through innovation, collaboration, and unwavering dedication to excellence. We work closely with our clients to deliver customised solutions that enhance their supply chain operations and drive their growth. Our commitment to innovation, sustainability, and excellence is reflected in every aspect of our business, as we strive to create a culture of teamwork, respect, and integrity.

art.alt: Ripplr warehouse with trucks, pallets and staff

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: Our goal is to become the top-tier Distribution and Logistics Provider, known for our exceptional service, innovative solutions, and customer satisfaction. We strive to be the frontrunner in utilizing technology and data to enhance supply chain operations, while providing unmatched benefits to our clients. We are dedicated to nurturing our team, promoting a culture of imagination, teamwork, and empowerment, and attracting the most brilliant minds in the industry.

journey.title: From one city to Nationwide Distribution & Logistics Network
journey.description: From our first operations in Bengaluru to serving India's biggest brands, here's how Ripplr grew from an idea into the backbone of modern Distribution and Logistics services.

milestones.title: Founded in Bengaluru
milestones.body: Established Ripplr with a vision to modernize India's FMCG distribution ecosystem through technology.

milestones.title: Distribution Vertical Started
milestones.body: Launched our core distribution platform, helping distributors streamline inventory, orders, and retailer operations.

milestones.title: Launched Tech Softwares for Business & Operations
milestones.body: Expanded into enterprise software, digitizing warehousing, logistics, collections, and operational workflows.

milestones.title: Onboarded Major Brands & Clients
milestones.body: Partnered with leading FMCG brands and rapidly expanded our distributor and retailer network across regions.

milestones.title: Launched Payments Management System
milestones.body: Introduced a digital collections platform with payment reconciliation, cheque management, and financial automation.

milestones.title: Made the Major Bank Integrations
milestones.body: Integrated with leading banking partners to enable secure, automated payment processing and reconciliation.

milestones.title: Electronic - Distribution Vertical Started
milestones.body: Expanded into electronics distribution, extending our technology platform beyond the FMCG ecosystem.

milestones.title: One Network, Nationwide
milestones.body: Serving retail counters across the country with a connected network of brands, distributors and fleet - and still growing.
